Gatekeeper
settings.detail: Checks that apps come from identified developers before they open.

settings.title: Offer “Anywhere” in Privacy & Security
settings.detail: Adds the “Anywhere” choice to “Allow applications from” and opens Privacy & Security so you can pick it. This does not turn Gatekeeper off by itself. Turning it off removes the choice and re-enables Gatekeeper.

settings.title: Remote Login (SSH)
settings.detail: Lets other computers sign in to this Mac over SSH.

settings.title: System Integrity Protection
settings.detail: Can only be changed from macOS Recovery, so Tinker reports it and nothing more.

settings.title: Computer name
settings.detail: The name that others see for this Mac in AirDrop, Sharing and the Finder sidebar on other devices. Also affects this device's iCloud name.

settings.title: Local host name
settings.detail: The name other devices on your network use, followed by .local. Letters, digits and hyphens only.

settings.title: Host name
settings.detail: The name Terminal and network tools report. Letters, digits, hyphens and dots only.

settings.title: Install security responses and system files
